blurb: PRANCE offers therapeutic riding lessons and integrated camps for children and adults with disabilities. Programs include horseback riding lessons, horsemanship, and equine-assisted therapy. The center focuses on physical, emotional, and social benefits through interaction with horses.
extraNote: Riders accepted on a trial basis · Priority given to children with special needs for camps · Financial help available for summer camp to qualifying applicants · Miramichi Farms, Eastern shore of Lake Huron near Port Elgin, Ontario · July and August for summer camps; spring and fall for riding sessions
